hooks.name: Run just check at the end of every activity

action.prompt: End-of-activity quality gate for the Shelfie repository. Do these steps before you finish. 1. Tests: if this activity changed code in app/, scripts/, tests/ or frontend/src/, make sure tests cover the change. Add or update pytest tests in tests/ for backend changes and vitest tests (frontend/src/**/*.test.ts(x)) for frontend logic. A behaviour change without a test is not finished. 2. Run `just check` from the repository root. It runs ruff lint and format check, mypy, bandit, pytest, tsc, vitest and the vite build. 3. If it fails, fix the root cause, use `just fix` for ruff lint and formatting findings, then run `just check` again. Repeat until it passes. Never make it pass by deleting or skipping tests, loosening tool configuration, or adding noqa, type: ignore or nosec without a short reason on the same line. 3a. Docs: every change to behaviour, data, API, UI or architecture MUST update the matching Markdown in docs/ in the same activity (docs/features/<feature>.md for per-feature logic, docs/architecture-overview.md and docs/agent-ag-ui-bedrock.md for structure and agents). A NEW feature, tab, agent, tool, script or data field gets its own section or file describing how it works, its data flow and, where useful, a Mermaid diagram, and is linked from docs/features/README.md. Ideas the user mentions for later go to docs/backlog.md. An activity that changed code but not docs is not finished. 4. If `just check` already passed in this activity after your last file change, do not run it again. 5. Do not add heavy dependencies just to make a check pass; fix the root cause. Finish with one line: `just check: passed` or `just check: failed - <reason>`.
